name: 稳定性研究与质量管理 (7GU)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item manages stability studies or shelf-life studies that can be conducted to track and examine how different environmental conditions (for example, temperature, brightness, moisture) affect a compound, a material, or a batch over a specified period.

You can track and examine how different environmental stability studies or shelf-life studies are carried out for self-produced or externally procured goods, above all, in the chemical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food industries.

Such studies are required to determine expiration dates during the development of new products (in Research & Development) and are mandatory to obtain legal approvals for products. In addition, stability studies are an important tool for continuously improving products and processes.

Key Process Flow

  • Create stability study​
  • Create initial samples with inspection as baseline
  • Plan stability study (define storage conditions and scheduling)​
  • Record inspection results of stability samples​
  • Record usage decisions of stability samples​

Business Benefits

  • Flexible control of all process steps within a single integrated environment​
  • Use the infrastructure of the stability study object (represented by a quality notification), which provides a variety of tools to perform all activities and process steps required in a stability study​
  • Enhance or modify the process steps to meet your company's specific requirements​
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目管理稳定性研究或货架寿命研究，可进行这些研究以跟踪和检查不同的环境条件（例如，温度、亮度、水分）在指定期间内如何影响化合物、物料或批次。

您可以跟踪和检查在化学、制药、化妆品和食品行业中如何对自产或外部采购的商品执行不同的环境稳定性研究或货架存放期研究。

在开发新产品期间（在研发中），需要进行此类研究以确定过期日期，并且必须获得产品的法律批准。此外，稳定性研究是持续改进产品和流程的重要工具。

关键流程流

  • 创建稳定性研究​
  • 创建初始样本，并将检验作为基线
  • 计划稳定性研究（定义存储条件和计划）​
  • 记录稳定性样本的检验结果​
  • 记录稳定性样本的使用决策​

业务优势

  • 在单一集成环境中灵活控制所有流程步骤​
  • 使用稳定性研究对象的基础架构（由质量通知表示），该基础架构提供各种工具来执行稳定性研究所需的所有活动和流程步骤​
  • 增强或修改流程步骤以满足公司的特定需求​
